outcome: duration of sensory and motor blockade
onset of sensory and motor block
cohort: 111 patients scheduled for lower abdominal surgical procedures under spinal anesthesia
finding: Clonidine as an adjuvant to bupivacaine in spinal anesthesia potentiated sensory and motor blockade and prolonged analgesia without affecting haemodynamic parameters compared to bupivacaine with magnesium sulphate or bupivacaine alone.
